title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 17:00 UTC on 29 September 2026.

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.33 (0P) at 17:00 UTC on 29 September. The 17:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 17:59; hour-start 0.33/0P, hour-end 0.67/1M). Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-29T16:48:00Z; label 1M). Published-window maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-29T14:44:00Z; label 1M). Window start 2026-09-29T12:57:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 18:00 UTC on 29 September hour is still incomplete (55 samples through 18:54).

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (17:00 UTC on 29 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The public feed is a rolling ~6-hour window, not a full-day archive.
